description: Atlyn Play Axis turns any date or category field into a player for your whole report. Bind one field, press play, and the visual walks through its values on a timer, filtering every other visual on the page as it goes - so a static report becomes an animated story without a single line of DAX. Three playback modes cover the ways people actually want to animate data. Step shows one value at a time. Cumulative grows the picture as playback advances, revealing how a total builds up. Rolling window keeps a moving span of N periods in view. Playback can loop, bounce back and forth, or run once, at a speed you set from half a second to a minute per step. Built for unattended displays. Auto-start begins playback the moment the report opens, the transport strip fades for a clean presentation and returns on hover or keyboard focus, and a large current-value caption stays readable across a room - ideal for wall-mounted TV dashboards and executive presentations. Playback waits for the report to finish rendering before advancing, so it never outruns a slow model. Works the way Power BI expects: bookmarks capture the current step, Sync Slicers carries the filter across pages, auto date hierarchies resolve correctly, and every control is keyboard operable with a persistent pause, high-contrast support and reduced-motion awareness. The included sample report demonstrates all three modes…
